review_rule: Read every complete pre-event question and company reply before any sixth-cohort model output. Use only company-confirmed facts and the frozen v6 ontology. Preserve incomplete states and reject question-only rumors, routine counts, static capabilities and stale disclosures. Each event needs a unique exact quote from the reply and each item an individual substantive reason. Do not use future prices, unseen disclosures or sixth-cohort model outputs.

bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive paired resampling of the fixed sixth company sample, not a population confidence interval.

score_interpretation: Agreement with one AI source-first review on a sixth company-disjoint, answer-visible, question-topic-enriched sample. This is not human-ground-truth accuracy, natural event prevalence, market prediction or regulatory-warning validity. Insufficient positive reference support blocks a five-type research signal even if observed F1 is high.
